feeds.title: Gorry Research Blog
feeds.description: We are an Irish genealogical practice operated by Paul Gorry, MAGI. Since 1987 we have carried out thousands of searches for clients from around the globe. In the first decade or so various researchers were engaged in the service, under Paul Gorry's supervision. Now Paul conducts most aspects of commissioned research, with the assistance of one researcher.

feeds.title: Roots Ireland Blog
feeds.description: RootsIreland offers a unique database of more than 23 million Irish records. The main sources on the site are Irish Catholic and other church records of baptisms, marriages, and deaths which are the most important source for tracing Irish ancestry. Find your Irish Ancestors today with the Irish Family History Foundation online research service

feeds.title: Genealogy Ie Blog
feeds.description: Genealogy. ie Ireland's specialists in family and local history research. We offer professional research services that have already helped many of your fellow family historians. Our articles are about our research, advice on record collections, research tips, local history, etc.

feeds.title: Jannet L. Walsh Blog
feeds.description: Jannet Walsh is the author of the forthcoming creative nonfiction quest narrative Higgledy-Piggledy Stones: Family Stories from Ireland and Minnesota. Read the blog and get tips for beginning your Irish genealogy search.

feeds.title: Claire Bradley Genealogy
feeds.description: I am Claire Bradley a Dublin-based genealogist specializing in Irish ancestry. As a professional genealogist, I can guide you in the right direction. In all cases, you would assist me by providing as much information as you have. People often know more than they realize!

feeds.title: John Grenham Blog
feeds.description: With a wealth of experience in the fields of Irish genealogy and history, he is able to offer expert advice and research services. Find your Irish ancestry with John Grenham's expert system.

feeds.title: Irish Family Roots Blog
feeds.description: Donna Moughty is a professional genealogist focusing on genealogical methodology and Irish research. Explore the Irish Family Roots Blog and learn about resources to help you start or improve your Irish Genealogy research skills.

feeds.title: Paul MacCotter Blog
feeds.description: Irish Genealogy, family history specialist and historical consultancy

feeds.title: Irish Family History Centre
feeds.description: The Irish Family History Centre has the experts and resources to help you tell your family story. We can provide the skills and supports to help you achieve your goals. Whether you're a new-comer to family history or an experienced researcher, we have advice, education, and research options for you to unlock your Irish Family History.

feeds.title: My Ireland Family Heritage Blog
feeds.description: My Ireland Family Heritage genealogy tours trace your Irish roots and find your ancestors' exact house location from the 1700s to the late 1800s and all available records in any county in Ireland. We are an Irish family heritage business dedicated to assisting you in your Irish ancestry research, for your roots and the records of your family history in any county in Ireland. We provide you with a once-in-a-lifetime Irish Genealogy tour experience to visit your family's original family house and Walk in the Footsteps of your Irish Ancestors.

feeds.title: Genetic Genealogy Ireland
feeds.description: Genetic Genealogy Ireland is a series of lectures and presentations on DNA and its usefulness in Irish family tree research. The aim of Genetic Genealogy Ireland is simple: to encourage more people living in Ireland today to have a DNA test.

feeds.title: Irish Genealogy News
feeds.description: The Irish Genealogy News is a blog report on the latest Irish genealogy developments and record releases, and it's read by professional and amateur genealogists who recognize its independence and wide coverage of news.

feeds.title: Ancestor Network Blog
feeds.description: Ancestor Network Limited is Ireland's leading provider of professional genealogy and probate research. We are made up of the largest team of experienced, qualified, professional, and expert genealogists across the island of Ireland. Collectively, our genealogists have over 450 years of research experience. Our unique panel of experts can provide an unmatched experience for the customer - whether an individual, a family, a business or an institution.
